latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release: Edit and export videos optimized for Instagram Reels and Stories.

- Upload video files (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB) for cloud-based processing.
- Edit videos with format adjustments (crop to 9:16, add captions, trim to 60 seconds).
- Fast cloud GPU rendering delivers 1080p MP4 output in 30–90 seconds.
- Designed for Instagram creators to streamline clip editing and exporting.
- Includes simple workflows: quick edit, batch processing, and iterative refinement.
- Automatic free token and session setup for new users.
